notes: 2 section headers — too few for a contents list.
1926 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Make a bold line a real heading
decisions.why: "Caretakers of our Earth Texts" is a paragraph in bold type. It reads as a heading and is spaced like one, but it is not in the page's outline, a screen reader does not announce it, and the contents list cannot link to it.

decisions.label: Make a bold line a real heading
decisions.why: "Family Links" is a paragraph in bold type. It reads as a heading and is spaced like one, but it is not in the page's outline, a screen reader does not announce it, and the contents list cannot link to it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 2 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 54 links on this page open a file — 54 PowerPoint — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.
